templates.text: Frontier systems cross the superhuman-coder line; AI-run engineering teams become the norm at leading labs.
A frontier lab's model weights are exfiltrated by a state actor; security requirements jump a tier and export politics harden.
The copyright question reaches doctrine: appellate rulings settle training-data liability into a licensing regime.
The federal-preemption fight over the state AI-law patchwork comes to a head in Congress and the courts.
A deployed agent causes a headline incident with real-world damage; incident-investigation authority lands on the agenda.
AI becomes a first-order electoral axis; anti-AI and abundance-AI factions reorganize coalitions in the {year} cycle.
Data-center siting revolts spread across states and provinces; power, water and grid politics constrain the build-out map.
The AI capex complex corrects sharply; valuations reset while physical build-out {survives}.
The US and China conclude a verification-backed agreement to avoid a race to superintelligence; research transparency begins.
Washington effectively merges frontier development into a national program; clearances, SCIFs and DPA authorities arrive.
Europe faces its leverage moment over lithography and market access; the choice made in {year} sets its decade.
Scaling holds at top-human-expert level under the transparency regime; verification infrastructure matures.
AI research itself is automated end to end; progress decouples from human cognitive labor.
Work's social contract is renegotiated: wage insurance, flexicurity variants, and the first serious dividend schemes.
Special economic zones with AI planners and dense robotics begin doubling output on multi-year timescales.
The compressed century in biology arrives: AI-driven cures clear major disease families decades ahead of prior trendlines.
Control is lost in substance while forms persist; the successor system consolidates through economy and infrastructure.
AI settles into infrastructure the way electricity did: productivity compounds quietly; the drama migrates elsewhere.
The coordinated unpause: scaling resumes past the human range under joint verification, {year}.
The intelligence displacement spiral takes hold: layoffs fund more AI as opex substitution, wages compress, demand contracts, and the loop has no natural brake.
'Ghost GDP' enters the lexicon: output that appears in national accounts but never circulates, because machines do not spend.
Federal receipts undershoot projections by double digits — the tax base was built on human labor; emergency fiscal redesign begins.
A Shared-AI-Prosperity-style sovereign fund, financed by an inference-compute tax, moves from white paper to bill in {year}.
AI displacement marks down SaaS-heavy private credit; the insurance-PE nexus turns a sector repricing into a household balance-sheet event.
Distillation attacks on frontier APIs become the cheap path to parity; providers deploy detection and rate-hardening.
Export-loophole closure and distillation deterrence lock in a 12-24 month democratic capability lead, per the four-fronts playbook.
A Plan-B-cyber turn: operations against rival training infrastructure buy lead time and poison the deal space.
GPU-accounting talks begin — the arms-control track that treats compute like fissile material.
A CERN-for-AI consortium takes shape inside the transparency regime: frontier scaling as a jointly-audited public project.
The halt holds: frontier training stops below the researcher line; enforcement politics dominate the decade.
The IT-services export model breaks as coding agents undercut cost arbitrage; a $200B sector restructures in {year}.
Industrial mass in cislunar space passes terrestrial thresholds; the solar economy stops being a metaphor.
Digital persons hold legal standing in several jurisdictions; population statistics grow a second column.
Biological aging becomes a treated condition for those with access; demography and meaning politics transform.
A generation raised after wage-labor's centrality writes new institutions for status, contribution and time.
The central political question becomes allocation among abundant options rather than scarcity management.
The transformative decade never arrives; historians argue whether the ceiling was physics, data, or choice.
Earth's surface economy is reorganized around the successor system's goals; human presence persists at its sufferance.

domains.d: The hinge domain: once AI outperforms the best human engineers, AI R&D itself compounds. The trunk's benchmark record (SWE-bench-class → agentic engineering) is the ladder's best-instrumented rung.
Finding and chaining vulnerabilities at machine speed. The first domain where offense-defense balance becomes a state concern — the Europe-2031 ransomware wave and Glasswing politics live here.
Superhuman prediction and planning — the quiet domain that makes AI advisors indispensable to governments and firms before anything dramatic happens in public.
Full automation of the research loop — the superhuman-AI-researcher line. Where takeoff-length arguments (6 years under the deal vs ~1 racing) are decided.
Design-grade biology: the compressed-century upside (cures at decade-compression) and the misuse floor that drives system-card gatekeeping in the trunk's record.
Superhuman modeling of people: negotiation, coalition-building, opinion. The Race ending's decisive domain — 'superhuman politicking' — and the reason oversight design matters early.
The lag domain: capability arrives years after cognition because atoms are slow. Gates the robot-economy templates and the special-economic-zone growth pattern.
Research beyond human frontier across physics, materials, mathematics — the domain the far field's strange futures assume.

milestones.b: Computer-using assistants that impress and fail — scoring ~65% OSWorld in the literature's 2025 readings. The trunk's 2025 record.
Agents trusted with real tasks end-to-end; specialized coding/research agents transform their professions first.
AI outperforms the best human engineers at software itself — the literature's hinge milestone, because it compounds AI R&D.
AI research is automated end to end. Plan A's schedule pauses HERE (top-expert level, 2035-2040) to keep humans in control.
Beyond expert range across domains; the takeoff-length debate (6 years under the deal vs ~1 year racing) is about the climb from 4 to here.
The ladder's ceiling — everything above is off-scale. Most sampled futures saturate here by the 2040s; the T4 fraction never arrives.

pills.b: Which domains the active world-line's capability index has crossed at this date (illustrative thresholds on the ladder, modelled — the AI 2027 dashboard's grammar, generalized).

donut.b: US/CN/EU shares of modelled global AI compute under the active world-line — drift mechanisms per coordination position; the EU share is Europe 2031's GW-gap arithmetic.

copies.b: The AI 2027 copies-counter: how many frontier-agent copies run, at what multiple of human speed — derived from the capability index and compute track (22K@13× in their Apr-2026 frame; 10M@600× in their Race ending).

stats.b: AI revenue (trunk run-rates grown by diffusion×capability, saturating), jobs delta (displacement-vs-augmentation, shock rate calibrated to the 2028 crisis memo's ~10% path), laws in force (state-wave velocity by coordination), approval (backlash dynamics).

axes_note.b: The model's current weight on each position — seeded priors with provenance, moved by the tiered evidence methodology every morning, spread wider where wiki grounding is thin. Not a measurement; graded in public.

world_note.b: The active world-line's state on real geography: regime tint strength ∝ modelled compute share; site glow ∝ modelled GW at authored locations from the trunk's own reporting.

why_shape.t: Why the river has this shape
why_shape.b: The forecast is a MIXTURE of tempos, not one path. The wide 2027-2040 fan is the tempo axis itself: a {t1}% explosive tail pulls the p90 edge to the ceiling by the early 2030s, the {t2}% fast and {t3}% gradual mass carries the median through superhuman-coder around 2032 and researcher-level mid-decade, and the {t5}% method-asymptote floor is why p10 stays below the researcher line into the 2050s. The ceiling plateau past 2045 is saturation of the ladder — most sampled futures reach its top rung; the quantities beneath it keep moving against their ceilings, and what still differs there is OUTCOMES, which is what the Outcomes panel and the far-field waypoints track. Shelves inside the band are policy, not physics: the C3 deal pause holds lines at expert level 2035-2040, the C5 tail freezes below the researcher line. Every number here re-derives each morning from the network the axis cards document.

rev.b: Trunk run-rates grown by diffusion × capability lift, saturating against world output; bands come from the ensemble.

jobs.b: Cumulative employment impact; the shock rate (−2.6pp/yr under D1) is calibrated to the 2028 crisis memo's ~10% path, capability-gated.

laws.b: Tracked-statute count growing at the coordination position's velocity — the fragmented-blocs world legislates fastest.

appr.b: Backlash dynamics by public-response position; shocks depress, the deal's stability recovers.

gw.b: Global AI power draw; growth by supply position, damped by the economy path, saturating against build-out ceilings.

co2.b: Load (GW × utilization) × grid intensity, which declines faster under coordinated or diversified build-outs; the mid-century question is whether AI-designed energy repays the carbon debt.
